actionGroups.name: HealthcarePatientActions
actionGroups.description: Patient-facing tools for summaries, billing, appointments, lab reports, admission status, prescriptions, and insurance.

functions.name: get_patient_summary
functions.description: Get a structured patient summary by Patient ID, name, DOB, or phone number.

functions.name: get_patient_billing
functions.description: Get billing amount and insurance provider details for a patient.

functions.name: get_patient_appointments
functions.description: Get appointment or admission-date details for a patient from available dataset columns.

functions.name: get_lab_reports
functions.description: Get lab or test result details for a patient.

functions.name: get_admission_status
functions.description: Get admission, room, discharge, and current status for a patient.

functions.name: get_discharge_summary
functions.description: Get diagnosis, treatment, medication, and discharge details for a patient.

functions.name: get_prescription_history
functions.description: Get medication/prescription history for a patient.

functions.name: get_insurance_details
functions.description: Get patient insurance details, or provider distribution when no patient is specified.

actionGroups.name: HealthcareDoctorActions
actionGroups.description: Doctor-facing tools for appointments, disease statistics, ICU patients, critical alerts, and record search.

functions.name: get_today_appointments
functions.description: Get today's appointment/admission records, optionally filtered by doctor or hospital.

functions.name: get_disease_statistics
functions.description: Get disease or diagnosis distribution from healthcare records.

functions.name: get_icu_patients
functions.description: Search available dataset columns for ICU or intensive-care patient records.

functions.name: get_critical_alerts
functions.description: Get emergency admissions or abnormal/critical test result records.

functions.name: search_healthcare_records
functions.description: Search dynamically across all healthcare dataset columns.

actionGroups.name: HealthcareAdminActions
actionGroups.description: Admin and hospital-management analytics for doctors, disease mix, revenue, insurance, and trends.

functions.name: get_doctor_analytics
functions.description: Get doctor appointment/admission workload and revenue analytics.

functions.name: get_revenue_analytics
functions.description: Get billing/revenue analytics from healthcare records.

functions.name: get_disease_statistics
functions.description: Get disease or diagnosis distribution from healthcare records.

functions.name: get_insurance_details
functions.description: Get insurance provider distribution across records.
